costStressUnderExposureAdjustment.reading: ILLUSTRATION ONLY. The -1.470pp bound is against a unit-beta 069500 path. Against the C2 book's own annual-row exposure the 3x point estimate stays positive. This is not executable alpha, not a confidence interval and does not separate stock selection from defensive style, timing or cash. Neither comparator is registered; the original fixed C2 method is unchanged.

downYearReading.reading: With beta < 1 a down benchmark year produces positive excess mechanically, (1 - beta) x |R_m|; the 5/5 down-year and 2/9 up-year counts are the signature of the exposure, not separate evidence of selection or timing.

leaveOneYearOutBeta.reading: Beta from 14 published annual/partial-year returns is a SENSITIVITY reading, not a verified daily exposure: one year moves it from 0.38 to 0.69.

limitations: 14 annual rows, two bookend partial years, 2025/2026 high leverage; no daily C2 path is published.
Arithmetic annual regression vs CAGR-based bounds: magnitudes are approximate and not additive.
The intercept cannot separate stock-specific selection from a defensive / low-beta factor premium.
Outcome-exposed history; no promotion, no rerun, no new path built.
